name: Camp OCP (OCP Summer Program)
description_short: A summer day program at the MetroWest YMCA in Framingham for kids entering grades 1-8. It focuses on preventing summer learning loss through English language arts, global learning, STEM and social-emotional activities, with swim most days and weekly field trips or visiting guests.
refund_policy_summary: You pay a non-refundable $50 deposit per week, per child, when you register. Extended care is paid in full at registration. Deposits can be moved to another camp program before April 1 but not after. The deadline for cancellations and transfers is May 31, and after that there are no refunds, credits or transfers. All changes must be sent in writing by email. If a child misses camp because of an illness or injury lasting 3 days or more, the Y may give a credit or a refund (minus the deposit) if you send a doctor's note before the session ends. There are no refunds or pro-rating for missed days.
special_needs_notes: The Y tries to accommodate children who need extra support and asks families to tell them about any needs ahead of time. However, it says it is "not a therapeutic or special needs organization." The Director of Inclusion is Laina Abolfazli: (508) 876-6094, labolfazli@metrowestymca.org.
swim_waterfront_notes: Swim lessons and free swim are included, but there is no swim on Mondays. Campers take a swim evaluation on the first day ("Test. Evaluate. Protect."), and new campers are tested on Mondays. Kids who test at the red-neckband level must wear a Coast Guard-approved flotation device during open swim. Campers can be retested on Fridays or on request.
